description:
Comprehensive improvements to the BenchBox MCP (Model Context Protocol) server
based on adversarial code review and industry best practices analysis. The
current implementation is functional but needs refinements for production
readiness, better error handling, enhanced testing, and alignment with
MCP 2025 specification updates.

This TODO addresses gaps identified through:
- Deep code review of benchbox/mcp/ (1,841 lines across 11 files)
- Analysis of MCP best practices from official docs and community guides
- Comparison with production MCP servers (GitHub MCP, FastMCP examples)
- Security and observability requirements for AI agent integration
